en.legend: Kiitos is a thank between two people. Kiitti is care for a thing, a plant or an animal.
en.none_p: This is where your entries will appear. When you thank someone on a HeartBank® app, or someone thanks you, it shows up here.
en.para: When you thank someone on a HeartBank® app, this service keeps an encrypted note that it happened. We timestamp a fingerprint of that note to a public ledger, so it can't be changed later without showing. The note itself stays private and yours: you can open it here and download it. What you wrote, and any amount or time, stays in the app you used. Nothing is paid here.

en.pk_p: A passkey is the face or fingerprint you already use to open your phone. It proves the person opening this record is you. Add one to your HeartBank® account, then come back.
